Timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp, serialized exactly as `time`'s `serde::rfc3339` module encodes it (e.g. "2024-01-15T09:30:00Z") -- generated code never owns this type; it always maps to shared::timestamp::Timestamp, a hand-written wrapper around time::OffsetDateTime.

Index.description: A position into a `Vec` -- an event-log cursor, a sequence step, a `Seek` target. JSON Schema's plain "uint" format is ambiguous between u32 and usize (both schemars and typify treat them identically), so this is its own named def and mapped onto Rust's actual `usize` by `shared/build.rs`, rather than inlined wherever it's used.

BattleLog.description: Event-sourced battle state. `Battle` is always derived by replaying `events[..cursor]` from genesis; undo/redo just moves the cursor, and pushing a new event truncates any redo tail. Battles are small (a handful of combatants, a few hundred events), so a full replay is cheap and there is no drift between the log and the derived state by construction.

SessionRejection.description: Why a `Join`'s `session` token was refused — split out from `ProtocolError` so the client can decide per-reason whether the room is still worth retrying without the token.

MemberName.description: A player's own display label -- replicated to every member of a room on every change, so an unbounded one makes one member's typing everyone else's bandwidth. Mirrors `MAX_NAME_LEN` (see `shared/src/protocol/name.rs`) -- a test asserts the two stay equal.

RoomName.description: A room's display name, as typed by whoever created it. Mirrors `MAX_ROOM_NAME_LEN`/`room_key`'s own validation (see `shared/src/protocol/name.rs`) -- a test asserts the bound stays equal.

AccessKey.description: An access code's key, whether server-generated or admin-chosen.

Label.description: A short user-facing label on a marker, sequence step, or commitment.

Note.description: Free-form user text attached to a revision or a declared action.
